stories.title: U-M wins on controversial finish; B1G backs review
stories.summary: Michigan got a second chance at a Hail Mary and connected in a 13-12 stunner over Western Michigan, as the Big Ten confirmed that officials correctly added time back on the clock to give the Wolverines another shot.

stories.title: Drama, delay doesn't dampen Kiffin's LSU debut
stories.summary: Arizona State transfer quarterback Sam Leavitt and Wisconsin transfer running back Dilin Jones combined for four rushing touchdowns in their new uniforms, and LSU ended a week of off-the-field drama with an easy 51-10 victory over Clemson.

stories.title: Antonelli comes from 19th to win home Italian GP
stories.summary: Kimi Antonelli dealt a seismic blow to George Russell's hopes of taking the world championship by passing his Mercedes teammate with just three laps remaining to win the Italian Grand Prix after he started 19th on the grid.

stories.title: Infantino sticking to reelection bid amid backlash
stories.summary: FIFA president Gianni Infantino has reiterated his desire to stand for re-election despite the continuing controversy surrounding his leadership.

stories.title: Vikes' Smith agrees to deal, back for 15th season
stories.summary: Vikings safety Harrison Smith is returning for a 15th season, with sources telling NFL Network he reached a one-year deal worth $12.25 million.
